name: New Jersey NJSIAA Meet of Champions Cross Country
headline: New Jersey NJSIAA Meet of Champions Cross Country
summary: New Jersey's fastest runners from every group race together at Holmdel. No. 1 Union Catholic's girls, who scored a perfect 15 at last week's Group meet, go for a fifth straight Meet of Champions title, with No. 19 Ridgewood also in the field. Ocean Township's Leah Starkey, the No. 2 girl in the country, ran 16:45 on this course last week. In the boys race, Union Catholic and No. 16 CBA meet again a week after Union Catholic beat CBA for the Non-Public A title, and CBA's Gavin Schmitt won that race in 15:27.
